## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally (unit tests for each package + `test:contract`)
- [ ] Commit / PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …)
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes observable behaviour (`README.md`, `docs/pipeline.md`, `docs/registry.md`, `docs/security.md`)
- [ ] No `.env` file, `FIGMA_TOKEN`, or other secret added anywhere in the diff
- [ ] No generated artefacts committed — `examples/*/src/stories/generated/` is build output, not source; don't `git add` it
